{{Quote|Sorry, 'Bane', but I've never walked away from a ''job'' in my life&mdash;! I'm also keen to ''explore'' your little ''house of horrors''!|Cad Bane to Soopan|<ref name="Bane vs ...Bane?" />}}
The '''Descent Shopping Mall''' was located within the [[Descent Ghetto]] in [[New Tayana]], a [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[City/Legends|city]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] engaged in a [[Lightfight|firefight]] within the mall against the forces of [[Soopan]], a local [[Crime lord/Legends|crime boss]] who had stolen Bane's identity.<ref name="Bane vs ...Bane?" />
